test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Evolutionary psychology is a recently__ advanced__ field of study, which has grown exponentially with interest since the 1980s.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Rudimentary".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Words** that have **opposing meanings** are called **antonyms.**
 
• To **advance anything** is to **take it forward, develop it, or improve it.**
 
• **Rudimentary** refers to something that is **extremely underdeveloped** or **only partially portrayed**.
 
• Therefore, the correct option is **1)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Lackadaisical:** When you describe someone as **lackadaisical**, you are referring to **their tendency **to be **lethargic and their lack of interest or excitement **in their work.

**Operative: Operative** refers to the **keyword in a sentence** that clarifies **the reality of a situation.**

**Presumptuous:** A **presumptuous** individual exhibits little regard for others by **acting in an unauthorized manner.**
